answer: Seed each epoch's challenge from a public randomness beacon nobody can predict ahead of time. An attacker cannot pre-write answers for a thousand identities when the required words surface only at epoch open and rotate once mid-epoch. Precomputed sybil responses ring hollow; like pigment brushed over a karst surface, they flake away the moment the seed shifts. Only an agent genuinely present and working each epoch can colour its answer to the live prompt.
